summary: This employment contract has several clauses that deserve attention before signing. The non-compete and unilateral amendment provisions are notably one-sided and warrant discussion with the other party.

clauses.text: Non-compete clause restricts employment for 24 months
clauses.explanation: Prohibits you from working for any competitor within the same industry for 24 months after leaving, regardless of reason for departure.
clauses.whyUnfair: The duration and scope are unusually broad. Most enforceable non-competes are limited to 6-12 months and a specific geographic area or role.
clauses.negotiationLanguage: Consider requesting a reduced term of 6 months, limited to your specific role, and scoped to direct competitors only rather than the entire industry.
clauses.exitGuidance: Enforceability varies significantly by state. Consult a local employment attorney to understand your actual exposure.

clauses.text: Employer may amend contract terms with 30 days notice
clauses.explanation: Allows the employer to change key contract terms — including compensation and duties — with only 30 days written notice.
clauses.whyUnfair: Material changes to compensation or role should require mutual consent, not unilateral notice.
clauses.negotiationLanguage: Request that any changes to compensation, title, or core responsibilities require written mutual agreement rather than unilateral notice.
clauses.exitGuidance: If changes are made that materially reduce your role or pay, you may have grounds to treat this as constructive dismissal in some jurisdictions.

clauses.text: At-will employment with standard notice period
clauses.explanation: Standard at-will employment with 2-week notice period from either party. Typical and reasonable for this type of role.

clauses.text: Intellectual property assignment covers work-related inventions
clauses.explanation: Assigns ownership of work-related inventions and creations to the employer. Standard for most employment relationships.

missingProtections: No severance terms specified for termination without cause
Missing dispute resolution or arbitration clause
No clear definition of what constitutes 'cause' for termination
preSigningChecklist: Confirm start date, base salary, and bonus structure in writing
Clarify the exact scope of the non-compete with legal counsel
Request a list of the direct competitors covered by the non-compete
Understand your benefits start date and coverage details
Ask what triggers the unilateral amendment clause in practice
